sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0032_lizhiyan_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_* (game 1.6). Every damage unit is plain ATK × blackboard key (no atkCalculation), including the combo skill's 'seal' buffs, which take their keys from the combo skill by assignBlackboard: seal_total ← atk_scale_touch; seal2 / seal_listener / seal_bunshin_end_listener ← atk_scale_boom (as atk_scale_early_finish); seal_finisher_wisd ← atk_scale_laser1 ×4 then atk_scale_laser2; seal_finisher ← atk_scale_laser2. Their decorate mask 12288 is the combo skill's (combo_skill_abilityentity_end has the same).

Skill type (Array Arcana) is chosen by the passive buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_passive: Intellect ≥ Will → INT, else WILL (panel attributes without buffs). Battle skill, ultimate sequence 2 and the combo's follow-up lasers branch on it; the engine can't select a hit by attribute yet, so INT hits carry no event keys.

Verified (Rhodagn / Lv90 challenge, game 1.6, parser v59), only when log buffs of stackingType 1 ('cannot stack', e.g. buff_wpn_funnel_0016_will_dmg / _will_atk) count once per buff ID: btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (P4, basic Lv11, WILL) all 13 Arcane hits ±1: seal_total ×2 = atk_scale_touch, ultimate = atk_scale, attack1 ×3 and attack2 ×3 = atk_scale, plunge = atk_scale, cryst bursts ×3; btl_upload_e82d45c46040 (P5, WILL) seal_total ×2 and ultimate ±1; btl_upload_0eef2474a26f (P5, WILL) seal_total and battle skill (atk_scale_will, under Corrosion level 2 from its own Nature-onto-Cryo reaction) ±1 even without that rule. The first two are in fixtures/pending/ because the current log check sums every logged instance.

Event keys are withheld (events: []) where fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json would fail: that battle (2026-10-15 01:55 +08:00, parser v58, before 555me's 1.6 table commit 371c743) has every Arcane, Gilberta and Typhoeus hit after Arcane's ultimate about 1.7–2.2× the 1.6 model. Inside it the INT hits are mutually consistent: seal_finisher_wisd lasers 1–4 / atk_scale_laser1, the final laser / atk_scale_laser2 (with its boundary susceptibility) and attack1 / atk_scale all give the same residual ×1.9617, and seal2 / atk_scale_boom equals battle skill / atk_scale_wisd (×2.2340 at t=12450).

Left out: power_attack (finisher, BreakingAttackCalculation, not ATK × key; the engine has no finisher zone), attack1_projhit and normal_skill_abilityrange (no skill spawns them in 1.6), and the ultimate's array aura buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_ultimate_skill_inaura_attack (atk_scale_laser default 3.0; no log shows it).
durationFrames are SkillData durationFrame (whole animation including recovery); basic attacks chain and skills cancel earlier, cancel windows aren't modelled.

hits.note: Three ChannelingActions at frame 10, one hit per target each (display_atk_scale = 3 × atk_scale). Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (3 hits of 537, basic Lv11 0.129). Logged as chr_0032_lizhiyan_attack1; key withheld because of fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json.
Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (3 hits of 712, 0.147 at Lv11). Logged as chr_0032_lizhiyan_attack2; key withheld because of fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json.
From SkillData only (display_atk_scale 0.75 ≈ 2 × 0.38); not in any log yet.
Two damage actions at each of frames 2, 5, 8, 11 (display_atk_scale 0.8 = 8 × 0.1); not in any log yet.
Final Strike (decorate mask 2097152 + basic); it also triggers the ultimate's Cluster Strike. Not in any log yet.
Uses the basic attack level. Verified on btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (8037, 1.66 at Lv11).

skills.label: Battle skill
skills.note: The skill spawns normal_skill_abilityrange2 at frame 0; its single hit lands at the entity's frame 20, after its Nature infliction in the same frame (so a Corrosion it causes already applies). Mask 4352 = battle.

hits.label: Battle skill (Array Arcana: WILL)
hits.note: Verified on btl_upload_0eef2474a26f (18470, crit, under Corrosion level 2). Logged as chr_0032_lizhiyan_normal_skill_abilityrange2; key withheld because of fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json, an INT battle that logs the same key.

hits.label: Battle skill (Array Arcana: INT)
hits.note: Same event key as the WILL hit; needs selection by Intellect ≥ Will. In btl_upload_d9e59d0fb737 its residual equals the seal2 explosion's (see sources).

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: The cast creates buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal_total at frame 9, which hits at its frame 6 (frame 15 of the skill). The explosion lands when Imprisonment ends (WILL 6 s / INT 4 s) or earlier when an INT battle skill ends it; the INT lasers follow that battle skill; neither has a fixed frame.

hits.label: Tactical Doubles hit
hits.note: One hit per target (four branches, one taken). Potential 1 multiplies atk_scale_touch by 1.3. Verified (0.8 × 1.3 = 1.04) on btl_upload_0eef2474a26f, btl_upload_e82d45c46040 ×2, btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 ×2. Logged as buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal_total; key withheld because of fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json.

hits.label: Explosion when Imprisonment ends
hits.note: Natural end: combo_skill_abilityentity_end; early end: the seal buffs, which deal atk_scale_boom passed as atk_scale_early_finish. The INT early end is also logged as buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal2 (key withheld: in fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json). Not verified in a 1.6 log yet.

hits.label: Bonus hits after an INT battle skill (lasers 1–4)
hits.note: buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal_finisher_wisd, buff frames 2, 5, 8, 11. Shares its event key with int_laser_final, and the log check maps a key to one hit only.

hits.label: Bonus hits after an INT battle skill (final laser)
hits.note: buff_chr_0032_lizhiyan_combo_skill_seal_finisher_wisd, buff frame 17. 4 × laser1 + laser2 = display_atk_scale_laser_wisd (5.0 at Lv12).

hits.label: Seal finisher (WILL branch)
hits.note: Created by combo_skill_abilityentity_seal_again's WILL branch; no log shows it yet.

hits.label: Array creation
hits.note: At frame 47, after the same frame's INT forced Corrosion (level 1) or WILL Susceptibility (talent 1), so those already apply to this hit. Verified on btl_upload_e82d45c46040 and btl_upload_b7b3762d5da8 (with the boundary Susceptibility). Logged as chr_0032_lizhiyan_ultimate_skill; key withheld because of fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json.

hits.label: Cluster Strike lasers
hits.note: A Finisher or Final Strike by the controlled operator on an enemy in the array triggers it, up to 2 times. inaura_laser1 and inaura_laser2 spawn 4 lasers each (laser_count 8, 8 × 0.45 = the 360% 'total' in the description); inaura_laser3 spawns 6 and its trigger isn't worked out. Not in any log yet.

hits.label: Gloompurge Arcana (WILL)
hits.note: Not in any log yet. WILL and INT share this event key.

hits.label: Gloompurge Arcana (INT)
hits.note: Potential 5 multiplies atk_scale by 1.3. During this skill INT also gains talent 1's Arts Amp (enhance_rate), which the kit can't express yet.
